text:
sophie: Heads-up — nightly e2e perf gate (longseq) failed on main at 02:15 UTC. p95 jumped ~55% vs baseline. Can someone quick-triage? :eyes:

ci-bot: [CI] Job failed: <https://ci.redwood.com/jenkins/job/nightly-longseq/5678|nightly-longseq#5678> - tests: e2e/perf, status: RED

perf-bot: Snapshot diff: p95 120ms -> 186ms (+55%), throughput -12%. Artifacts: /artifacts/perf/5678/summary.json

devon: I can take a look. When did the job start and what commit?

sophie: job started at 02:15 UTC, commit 7b3a2f9 (merge PR #842).

arjun: suspicious change: PR #842 touched batching logic and KV cache eviction thresholds — could regress long-seq.

maria: @devon quick idea: try rerun with env override `REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX_SEQ=4096` (was 2048) to rule batching policy. Here's how to rerun:

```
# Jenkins param override
curl -X POST 'https://ci.redwood.com/jenkins/job/nightly-longseq/buildWithParameters' \
  --data token=RETRIGGER_TOKEN \
  --data REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX_SEQ=4096 \
  --data COMMIT=7b3a2f9
```

devon: running that now (retriggered job 5680). Will post logs. :zap:

ci-bot: [CI] Job queued: <https://ci.redwood.com/jenkins/job/nightly-longseq/5680|nightly-longseq#5680>

sre-oncall: infra note — we had a rolling kernel patch on the inference fleet 02:05-02:10 UTC. if rerun fails, check node kernel versions and host load.

devon: ok first rerun p95 still high: 180ms. I think infra not the cause. Starting bisect across recent merges. plan: binary search across last 8 merges using `./tools/e2e_bisect.sh --range=8 --test=longseq`

```
# bisect run (local coordinator)
./tools/e2e_bisect.sh --range=8 --test=longseq --parallel=4 --commit=7b3a2f9
```

perf-bot: bisect step 1 results: commits 7a1..7e4 good, 7f5..7b3 bad. narrowing.

arjun: that matches my suspicion — PR #842 is in the bad range. @maria can you pull a quick revert of the batching tweak into a temp branch and we can run e2e smoke?

maria: creating revert branch `revert/pr-842-batching` and kicking a smoke run.

ci-bot: [CI] Job passed: <https://ci.redwood.com/jenkins/job/smoke-revert/890|smoke-revert#890> — latency p95 back to 118ms.

devon: great — revert branch looks good. I'll open a revert PR and link results. if maintainers agree we'll revert and then re-evaluate batching changes with smaller step.

sophie: thanks team. @devon can you post the bisect artifact and open the revert PR? I'll coordinate rollout hold.

devon: will do. artifact: /artifacts/bisect/2105556789/results.html . PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/855 (WIP revert).

maria: adding perf-regression label and tagging @eng-runtime. Also adding a test to cover longseq batching boundaries.

sre-oncall: noted — I'll hold infra changes for next hour in case we need to repro.

perf-bot: final: bisect points to commit 7f5b2c3 (PR #842) as first bad. attaching trace /traces/7f5b2c3.

devon: assigning to @arjun to propose a proper fix or revert. :handshake:

sophie: closing triage for now — followups in PR thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
